content.short: DIMO is an open, connected vehicle platform for drivers and fleets to get the most from their cars.
content.description: DIMO provides an open, connected vehicle platform for drivers and fleets to maximize the value of their cars. By leveraging data, it helps users save money and gain actionable insights on how to care for their vehicles more effectively. Sharing data with DIMO enables driving apps to serve vehicle owners rather than the app creators, promoting user-centric functionality and ensuring that app benefits align with the interests of the vehicle owners.
